en: Win or lose, it all comes down to a roll of the dice. That's the thrill of it.
I'm Grimsley of the Elite Four, and my Dark-type Pokémon play to win. Let's see where the dice land.
Another round, then? I never turn down a game. Let's play!
Well, well. The dice weren't with me today. No regrets, though. I played my hand as well as I could.
A light began to glow in the corner of the room.
A loss is a loss. I'll take it with a smile, and I'll be back at the table soon enough.
The light carried {player} back down to the hall.
